tools.name: spendguard_evaluate
tools.description: Free. Check a proposed Base USDC payment against a spending policy you supply (per-transaction limit, daily budget, human-approval threshold, allowed recipients) before money moves. Returns APPROVE, HUMAN_APPROVAL or BLOCK with findings. Advisory only: it never signs, holds keys or moves funds.

tools.name: quick_check
tools.description: Fast pre-payment sanity check for agents on Base: confirms the RPC reports Base mainnet (chain ID 8453) and that the official USDC contract has deployed code. No request body. Returns PASS or FAIL with both checks and a timestamp. It is not a token-risk report, transaction simulation or payment proo

tools.name: token_risk
tools.description: Token-risk report for one Base ERC-20 contract. Checks whether the token can be sold (honeypot simulation), buy/sell/transfer tax, owner privileges (mint, pause, blacklist, balance changes, proxy upgrades), holder concentration and DEX liquidity. Returns ALLOW, WARN, BLOCK or INCOMPLETE with scored

tools.name: preflight
tools.description: Simulate one unsigned Base transaction before an agent signs it. tools.name: verify_payment
tools.description: Verify one Base USDC payment onchain before an agent releases goods or credit. Reads the transaction receipt and checks the official USDC Transfer logs against the expected recipient, amount and optional sender. findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "quick_check" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "A deterministic Base chain identity and official USDC contract-presence check. No request body. Not a token-risk report, transaction simulation, or payment proof. Paid tool: 0.00098 USDC per call on Base via x402 (exact scheme). An unpaid call returns the payment requirement and charges nothing." → after: "Fast pre-payment sanity check for agents on Base: confirms the RPC reports Base mainnet (chain ID 8453) and that the official USDC contract has deployed code. No request body. Returns PASS or FAIL with both checks and a timestamp. It is not a token-risk report, transaction simulation or payment proo"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
